import math
import sys

MOD = 998244353

class FFT:
    MAX_K = 21
    MAX_N = 1 << MAX_K
    wR = [0.0] * MAX_N
    wI = [0.0] * MAX_N
    rR = [0.0] * MAX_N
    rI = [0.0] * MAX_N
    aR = [0.0] * MAX_N
    aI = [0.0] * MAX_N
    n = 0
    k = 0
    lastK = -1
    bitReverse = [0] * MAX_N

    @staticmethod
    def performFFT(inverse):
        if FFT.lastK != FFT.k:
            FFT.lastK = FFT.k
            FFT.bitReverse[0] = 0
            group = -1
            for i in range(1, FFT.n):
                if (i & (i - 1)) == 0:
                    group += 1
                FFT.bitReverse[i] = FFT.bitReverse[i ^ (1 << group)] ^ (1 << (FFT.k - 1 - group))
            
            FFT.wR[1] = 1.0
            FFT.wI[1] = 0.0
            for t in range(FFT.k - 1):
                angle = math.pi / FFT.n * (1 << (FFT.k - 1 - t))
                cosVal = math.cos(angle)
                sinVal = math.sin(angle)
                p2 = 1 << t
                p3 = p2 << 1
                j = p2
                idx = j * 2
                while j < p3:
                    FFT.wR[idx] = FFT.wR[j]
                    FFT.wI[idx] = FFT.wI[j]
                    FFT.wR[idx + 1] = FFT.wR[j] * cosVal - FFT.wI[j] * sinVal
                    FFT.wI[idx + 1] = FFT.wR[j] * sinVal + FFT.wI[j] * cosVal
                    j += 1
                    idx += 2
        
        for i in range(FFT.n):
            rev = FFT.bitReverse[i]
            if i < rev:
                temp = FFT.aR[i]
                FFT.aR[i] = FFT.aR[rev]
                FFT.aR[rev] = temp
                temp = FFT.aI[i]
                FFT.aI[i] = FFT.aI[rev]
                FFT.aI[rev] = temp
        
        if inverse:
            for i in range(FFT.n):
                FFT.aI[i] = -FFT.aI[i]
        
        len_val = 1
        while len_val < FFT.n:
            for i in range(0, FFT.n, len_val):
                wIndex = len_val
                j = i + len_val
                it = 0
                while it < len_val:
                    realPart = FFT.aR[j] * FFT.wR[wIndex] - FFT.aI[j] * FFT.wI[wIndex]
                    imagPart = FFT.aR[j] * FFT.wI[wIndex] + FFT.aI[j] * FFT.wR[wIndex]
                    wIndex += 1
                    FFT.aR[j] = FFT.aR[i] - realPart
                    FFT.aI[j] = FFT.aI[i] - imagPart
                    FFT.aR[i] += realPart
                    FFT.aI[i] += imagPart
                    it += 1
                    i += 1
                    j += 1
            len_val <<= 1

    @staticmethod
    def multiply(first, second):
        len1 = len(first)
        len2 = len(second)
        FFT.k = 0
        FFT.n = 1
        while FFT.n < len1 + len2 - 1:
            FFT.n <<= 1
            FFT.k += 1
        
        for i in range(FFT.n):
            FFT.aR[i] = first[i] if i < len1 else 0.0
            FFT.aI[i] = second[i] if i < len2 else 0.0
        
        FFT.performFFT(False)
        FFT.aR.append(FFT.aR[0])
        FFT.aI.append(FFT.aI[0])
        factor = -1.0 / FFT.n / 4.0
        
        for i in range(FFT.n - i + 1):
            real1 = FFT.aR[i] * FFT.aR[i] - FFT.aI[i] * FFT.aI[i]
            imag1 = FFT.aR[i] * FFT.aI[i] * 2
            real2 = FFT.aR[FFT.n - i] * FFT.aR[FFT.n - i] - FFT.aI[FFT.n - i] * FFT.aI[FFT.n - i]
            imag2 = FFT.aR[FFT.n - i] * FFT.aI[FFT.n - i] * -2
            newReal = -imag1 + imag2
            newImag = real1 - real2
            FFT.aR[i] = newReal * factor
            FFT.aI[i] = newImag * factor
            FFT.aR[FFT.n - i] = FFT.aR[i]
            FFT.aI[FFT.n - i] = -FFT.aI[i]
        
        FFT.performFFT(True)
        result = [0] * (len1 + len2 - 1)
        for i in range(len(result)):
            result[i] = round(FFT.aR[i]) % MOD
        
        return result

    @staticmethod
    def multiplyPrecise(first, second):
        sqrtMod = int(math.isqrt(MOD))
        aLow = [0] * len(first)
        aHigh = [0] * len(first)
        bLow = [0] * len(second)
        bHigh = [0] * len(second)
        
        for i in range(len(first)):
            aLow[i] = first[i] % sqrtMod
            aHigh[i] = first[i] // sqrtMod
        
        for i in range(len(second)):
            bLow[i] = second[i] % sqrtMod
            bHigh[i] = second[i] // sqrtMod
        
        r11 = FFT.multiply(aLow, bLow)
        r12 = FFT.multiply(aLow, bHigh)
        r21 = FFT.multiply(aHigh, bLow)
        r22 = FFT.multiply(aHigh, bHigh)
        
        result = [0] * len(r11)
        sqrtMod_sq = (sqrtMod * sqrtMod) % MOD
        
        for i in range(len(result)):
            result[i] = (sqrtMod_sq * r22[i] % MOD +
                        (sqrtMod * ((r12[i] + r21[i]) % MOD)) % MOD +
                        r11[i]) % MOD
        
        return result

def exponentiate(base, exp):
    if exp == 1:
        return base[:]
    if exp & 1:
        return FFT.multiplyPrecise(base, exponentiate(base, exp - 1))
    half = exponentiate(base, exp >> 1)
    return FFT.multiplyPrecise(half, half)

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    if not data:
        return
    
    n = int(data[0])
    k = int(data[1])
    base = [0] * 10
    idx = 2
    for i in range(k):
        base[int(data[idx])] = 1
        idx += 1
    
    res = exponentiate(base, n // 2)
    total = 0
    for val in res:
        total = (total + (val * val) % MOD) % MOD
    
    print(total)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
